part.content: {"reply":{"text":"Thank you for reaching out. We understand the flickering near the controller and the overheating concern. Please cut the power to the strip and inspect the controller plug. If the flicker persists, the controller is covered under warranty and will be replaced. If the controller feels hot, unplug it immediately and do not turn it on until it has been inspected. We cannot issue store credit at this time, but you can contact support for further assistance.","citations":[{"chunk_id":"kb_strip0flck","quote":"If a Flow strip flickers near the controller, cut the power and check the controller plug. If the flicker comes back, the controller is replaced under warranty."},{"chunk_id":"kb_ctrlheat01","quote":"If the controller body is hot to the touch, unplug the strip at once and do not switch it on until it has been checked."}]} }
